methodology: 11 shuffled matched rounds; identical bundles, frozen static runtime runners and C references. Each run warms 150 ms then measures 11 calibrated batches; every checksum and stdout is verified against the instruction engine. Symmetric inclusive 1.5xIQR applied within each run and across run medians; raw samples and excluded indices retained.  Host gate: every measured job runs pinned (inherited affinity, no wrapper) to one logical CPU of the quietest core, chosen again before each attempt once its other hyperthread has settled, and is repeated unless that CPU kept its clock within 3% of the job median (10th to 90th percentile), the median reached 95% of the clock calibrated at start, and the hyperthread sibling was busy at most 15% of the job; Go runs with GOMAXPROCS=1 on that CPU. Rejected attempts are retained with their observations.
